stories.title: Mola Mushkil Kusha (A.S.) aur Iran ka Lakrihara
stories.subtitle: Iran ke ghareeb lakrihare, heere, shehzadi ke haar aur qaid ki mashhoor kahani
stories.label: Riwayati majlisi hikayat • tareekhi sanad tasdeeq shuda nahin
stories.text:
Shehr-e-Iran mein ek ghareeb lakrihara rehta tha. Woh roz jungle se lakriyan kaat kar bazaar mein bechta aur apni biwi aur beti ki rozi ka bandobast karta tha. Ek din uski beti pados ke ghar gayi. Wahan ek aurat kaleji paka rahi thi. Bachchi ka bhi dil chaha, magar padosan ne usay kuch na diya. Ghar aakar usne apne baap se kaha, "Baba jaan, kal mere liye kaleji zaroor lana."

Lakrihara bohat pareshan hua. Uske paas ghar ke mamooli kharch ke liye bhi paisay na thay. Usne beti se wada kiya ke do din ki lakriyan ikatthi kar ke bechay ga aur phir uski khwahish poori karega. Beti ne umeed ke saath intezar karna qabool kar liya.

Pehle din woh jungle mein lakriyan jama kar ke rakh aaya. Lekin doosre din wapas pohncha to saari lakriyan jali hui raakh ban chuki theen. Uski mehnat zaya ho gayi. Woh gham se rone laga aur be-hosh ho gaya. Riwayati kahani ke mutabiq, usne is haalat mein ek naqab-posh buzurg ko dekha. Buzurg ne zameen se chand sangrezay utha kar usay diye aur yaad dilaya ke jab pareshani door ho to Mola Mushkil Kusha (A.S.) ke naam se shukr aur niyaz ko na bhoolna.

Hosh aaya to sangrezay uski mutthi mein thay. Woh unhen jeb mein daal kar ghar laut aaya, lekin beti se kiya hua wada poora na hone ke sabab darwazay ke peechhe chup gaya. Beti ne usay dekha aur andar bulaya. Lakrihare ne kaha ke woh uske liye kaleji nahin la saka. Beti ne tasalli di: "Baba jaan, andar aaiye; Allah Kareem hum par bhi karam karega."

Shaam ko lakrihare ne woh sangrezay beti ko khailnay ke liye de diye. Bachchi ne unhen ek kamray mein rakh diya. Subah uski biwi ne kamray mein ghair mamooli roshni dekhi. Dono miyan biwi ne dekha to sangrezay qeemti jawahiraat ki tarah chamak rahe thay. Lakrihara ek heera johri ke paas le gaya. Johri ne uski bohat qeemat lagai. Lakrihare ne us raqam se us jagah zameen khareedi jahan usay sangrezay milay thay aur wahan ek bara ghar banwaya.

Kuch arsay baad lakrihare ne safar-e-Hajj ka irada kiya. Janay se pehle usne ghar walon ko shukr aur niyaz yaad rakhnay ki naseehat ki. Magar ameer honay ke baad uski beti mein ghuroor aa gaya. Ek din woh apni walida ke saath hammam gayi. Wahan badshah ki malika aur shehzadi aane walay thay. Jab baqi log uth kar janay lagay to maa aur beti ne apni daulat par naaz karte hue wahan se janay se inkar kiya.

Shehzadi se lakrihare ki beti ki dosti ho gayi. Baad mein woh mahal bhi jaanay lagi. Ek din shehzadi ka qeemti haar ghaib ho gaya. Nokarani ne ilzaam lakrihare ki beti par laga diya. Maa aur beti ne baar baar apni be-gunahi bayan ki, magar badshah ne dono ko qaid karwa diya aur unke mahal ke saamne deewar khari kar di.

Idhar safar mein lakrihara lut gaya aur wapas aaya. Usne apne ghar ko band aur biwi beti ko qaid paya. Badshah se iltija ki, lekin baat na bani. Lakrihare ne kaha ke agar uske ghar walon ko reha nahin kiya ja sakta to usay bhi qaid kar diya jaye. Qaid mein usne poocha ke kya uske janay ke baad shukr aur niyaz ko yaad rakha gaya tha? Ghar walay sharminda hue. Kahani mein aata hai ke raat ko usay phir us naqab-posh buzurg ki ziyarat hui, jinhon ne usay bistar ke neeche paanch paisay dekhne aur unse mithai mangwa kar niyaz yaad karne ko kaha.

Subah waqai usay paanch paisay milay. Qaid khanay ke paas se guzarnay walay ek naujawan se usne mithai lanay ki darkhwast ki, magar naujawan ne mazaaq uraya aur inkar kar diya. Kahani ke mutabiq uske baad us naujawan ke saath ek sakht haadsa pesh aaya. Uska ghamzada walid guzra to lakrihare ne us se bhi mithai mangwai. Us aadmi ne uski baat maan li. Lakrihare ne shukr ki dua ki aur mithai mein se kuch us aadmi ko diya. Riwayati matn mein aage naujawan ki ghair mamooli sehat-yabi ka zikr hai.

Isi dauran badshah khanay par baitha tha ke ek chiriya ghaib shuda haar la kar usi khunti par rakh gayi jahan se woh ghaib hua tha. Badshah ko haqeeqat ka andaza hua aur usne lakrihare ke khandan ko azad kar diya. Riwayati kahani ka anjaam shukr, inkisari, insaf aur mushkil waqt mein Allah se umeed bandhay rakhnay ke sabaq par hota hai.

Yeh matn screenshots mein nazar aane wali mashhoor kahani ki Roman Urdu mein dobara likhi hui surat hai. Isay tareekhi tor par sabit shuda hadis na samjha jaye.
stories.sourceTitle: Mojza Mola Mushkil Kusha — provided screenshot matching Urdu narrative

stories.title: Chat Pat Bibi ka Mojza
stories.subtitle: Nasrani bibi, buzurg khatoon aur Janab-e-Fizza (S.A.) ki dawat
stories.label: Mashhoor riwayati kahani • mustanad tareekhi hadis nahin
stories.text:
Ek Nasrani bibi apne shohar ke saath bohat saadgi aur tangdasti mein rehti thi. Unki koi aulaad na thi. Shohar mehnat mazdoori karta, aur jo kuch milta usi se ghar chalta. Dono sabr aur shukr se zindagi guzaarte thay. Saal guzarte gaye aur burhapa qareeb aa gaya. Bibi ko fikr rehnay lagi ke unke baad unki nasal ka koi nishan baqi na hoga.

Ek din ek buzurg khatoon unke ghar aaeen aur poocha ke woh aaj kal itni udaas kyun rehti hain. Nasrani bibi ne apni be-aulaadi ki baat sunai. Buzurg ne unhen umeed dilai ke Allah ke ikhtiyar mein sab kuch hai; woh jisay chahe aulaad ata farmaye. Buzurg ne unhen Chat Pat Bibi ki kahani sunne ki niyyat aur dua ki taraf mutawajjah kiya.

Mashhoor hikayat ke mutabiq kuch arsay baad Nasrani bibi ke ghar ek khubsurat bachcha paida hua. Woh bohat khush hueen, lekin pareshan bhi theen ke jo mannat maani thi usay kis tarah poora karen. Unhon ne pehle buzurg se is ka tareeqa nahin poocha tha.

Shaam ko wahi naqab-posh buzurg khatoon dobara aaeen. Nasrani bibi ne shukriya ada kiya aur darkhwast ki ke mannat ka tareeqa samjha diya jaye. Buzurg ne riwayati kahani sunanay aur sab ke saath bantnay ka zikr kiya. Phir unhon ne ek doosri kahani sunana shuru ki, jo Janab-e-Sayyeda Fatima Zahra (S.A.), Ameer-ul-Momineen Ali (A.S.), Imam Hasan (A.S.), Imam Husain (A.S.) aur Janab-e-Fizza se mutalliq hai.

Us kahani mein aata hai ke ek martaba Mola Ali (A.S.) ghar mein jau ka aata laaye aur Janab-e-Sayyeda (S.A.) ne us se rotiyan tayyar keen. Rasool-e-Khuda (S.A.W.W.) ko khanay ki dawat di gayi. Aap tashreef laaye aur ahl-e-khana ke saath khana tanawul farmaya. Rukhsat hotay hue Janab-e-Sayyeda (S.A.) ne aglay din phir aane ki iltija ki, jo qabool hui.

Phir Imam Hasan (A.S.) ne apne nana jaan se dawat qabool karne ki darkhwast ki. Agli martaba Imam Husain (A.S.) ne bhi muhabbat se yahi arz ki. Mashhoor matn ke mutabiq dono shahzadon ki darkhwastein qabool huin aur ghar mein mehman-nawazi ka silsila chalta raha.

Jab Rasool-e-Khuda (S.A.W.W.) ek roz rukhsat ho rahe thay to Janab-e-Fizza ne bhi arz ki ke aap unki taraf se dawat qabool farma lein. Dawat qabool ho gayi, magar aglay din Fizza ke paas khanay ka bandobast na ho saka. Ramazan ka waqt tha. Riwayati kahani mein aata hai ke Maghrib ke baad Rasool-e-Khuda (S.A.W.W.) tashreef laaye aur maloom hua ke aaj ki mehman-nawazi Fizza ke zimmay hai.

Fizza ne apni pareshani kisi par zahir karne ke bajaye wuzu kiya, do rakat namaz ada ki aur Allah se dua maangi ke apne mehman aur Ahl-e-Bait ke saamne unki laaj rakhay. Kahani ke mutabiq dua ke baad ghar mein khanay ki khushbu phail gayi aur ek dastarkhwan ka intizam ho gaya. Jab poocha gaya ke yeh khana kahan se aaya to Fizza ne isay Allah ki ata bataya.

Is riwayati kahani mein Nasrani bibi ke sabr aur Janab-e-Fizza ki dua ko ek saath bayan kiya jata hai. Yeh screenshots ka Roman Urdu retelling hai, lafz-ba-lafz ya sanad ke saath sabit shuda tareekhi riwayat nahin.
stories.sourceTitle: Chat Pat Bibi Ka Mojza — Paheliyan.pk screenshot and Kahaniyan.org cross-check

stories.title: Janab-e-Sayyeda (S.A.) ki Kahani — Sunaran
stories.subtitle: Sonaran aur kumhar ke aawe ki kahani; attached kitab ke nazar aane walay safhat
stories.label: Scribd screenshots ke dikhai dene walay hisson ki retelling • mukammal 49-page matn nahin
stories.text:
Janab-e-Sayyeda ki kahani bar-e-sagheer ki mashhoor majlisi riwayaton mein se hai. Iski ibtida ek sunaran, yaani sunar ki biwi, se hoti hai. Kahani mein bayan hota hai ke ek din usay apne kam-umar bachay ke mutalliq bohat pareshan-kun khabar mili. Kaha gaya ke bachcha kumhar ke garam aawe ke qareeb haadse ka shikar ho gaya hai. Maa par gham ka pahaad toot para aur woh be-hosh ho gayi.

Riwayati matn ke mutabiq be-hoshi ke aalam mein usay ek naqab-posh bibi ki ziyarat hui. Usay Janab-e-Sayyeda Fatima Zahra (S.A.) se mansoob kahani aur Allah se dua ki taraf mutawajjah kiya gaya. Kuch dair baad bachay ke mehfooz honay ki khushkhabri mili. Sunaran ne Allah ka shukr ada kiya aur khushi mein logon ko ikattha kar ke kahani sunanay ki niyyat ki.

Woh mithai le kar aas paas ki auraton ke paas gayi, lekin usay koi saath na de saka. Riwayat mein aata hai ke uski mayoosi ke waqt phir ek naqab-posh khatoon saamne aaeen aur usay ek aur kahani sunai. Iske baad Janab-e-Sayyeda (S.A.) ki muhabbat, dua aur ek shadi ki mehfil ke waqiat bayan hotay hain. Kahani mein nek niyyat, dua, insani hamdardi aur shukr ka paigham ubhar kar aata hai.

Attached Scribd tasveeron mein "Janab-e-Sayyeda ki Kahani" ke kuch ibtedai aur darmiyani safhay dikhaye gaye hain. Un mein ek aurat ki pareshani, ahl-e-khana aur Janab-e-Sayyeda ke waseelay se dua ka silsila nazar aata hai. Kyunke poori 49 safhat ki kitab screenshots mein nahin di gayi, is entry mein uska mukammal lafzi matn hone ka daawa nahin kiya ja raha.

Yeh bar-e-sagheer mein sunai jaanay wali ek mashhoor aqeedat-mandana hikayat hai. Iska maqsad riwayat ko usi haisiyat se pesh karna hai, na ke isay tasdeeq-shuda hadis ya lazmi sharai amal kehna.
stories.sourceTitle: Janab-e-Sayyeda ki Kahani — user-attached Scribd page screenshots (partial)

stories.title: Mola Ghazi Abbas (A.S.) — Umm-ul-Banin aur Wafa
stories.subtitle: Aap ke bataye hue ibtedai jumlay ka hawala; tasdeeq-shuda seerat ka khulasa
stories.label: Seerat ka referenced khulasa • aap ki maangi hui mukammal mojza kahani abhi na-mili
stories.text:
Janab-e-Fatima Zahra (S.A.) ki wafat ke baad Ameer-ul-Momineen Mola Ali (A.S.) ne Janab-e-Umm-ul-Banin (S.A.) se nikah farmaya. Unka asal naam Fatima bint Hizam tha aur woh Banu Kilab ke ek ma'roof khandan se thin. Shia seerat ke mutabiq Mola Ali (A.S.) ne apne bhai Hazrat Aqeel se ek bahadur aur shareef khandan ki khatoon ke baray mein mashwara kiya tha.

Janab-e-Umm-ul-Banin (S.A.) ke batan se Mola Ali (A.S.) ke chaar betay paida hue: Abbas, Abdullah, Jafar aur Usman. Hazrat Abbas (A.S.) apni shujaat, ibadat, haya aur Imam Husain (A.S.) se ghair mamooli wafadari ke liye mashhoor hain. Aap ko Qamar-e-Bani Hashim aur Alamdar-e-Karbala ke alqaab se yaad kiya jata hai.

Riwayati seerat mein bayan hota hai ke Janab-e-Umm-ul-Banin (S.A.) ne Bibi Fatima Zahra (S.A.) ki aulaad ka bohat adab kiya aur unki khidmat ko apne liye sharaf samjha. Mola Abbas (A.S.) ki tarbiyat mein bhi Imam Husain (A.S.) ki ita'at aur gharana-e-Risalat se muhabbat ko markazi maqam hasil tha.

Karbala mein Hazrat Abbas (A.S.) ne apne Imam ke saath wafadari ki azeem misaal qaim ki. Isi nisbat se unhen Bab-ul-Hawaij keh kar pukara jata hai. Ziyarat, dua aur aqeedat ki adabi riwayaton mein aap ki karamaten bhi sunai jati hain.

Aap ne jis khaas mojza ka aaghaz bataya — "Janab-e-Fatima ki wafat ke baad Umm-ul-Banin ke batan se aik bacha paida hoga jiska naam Abbas hoga" — uski mukammal, wohi matn wali kahani kisi qabil-e-tasdeeq manba mein abhi nahin mili. Upar sirf us ibtida se mutalliq seerat ka hawala diya gaya hai. Baaqi waqiat apni taraf se gharr kar is naam se shamil nahin kiye gaye.
stories.sourceTitle: Al-Kafeel — Umm-ul-Banin aur Hazrat Abbas (A.S.) ki seerat
